events.title: International Climate Negotiations: Fossil Fuel Phase Out Scenarios with En-Roads
events.description: Explore how today's policy and technology choices can shape the future using En-Roads, a world-class energy & climate action simulator developed by Climate Interactive and MIT Sloan.
events.blurb: Try the En-Roads climate simulator and test how different policy and technology choices could phase out fossil fuels.

events.title: Teen Volunteer Club: Letters Against Isolation
events.description: Teens age 13+ can earn volunteer hours by writing letters for seniors with Letters Against Isolation. Registration is not required, but you can register for an email reminder.
events.blurb: Write letters for seniors through Letters Against Isolation and earn volunteer hours if you're a teen age 13 or older; registration isn't required.
